content.comment_body: I received an email from mySupport about updating [product_name] for Windows 10. I own the original DVD with [product_name] [version_no] and want to upgrade to [version_no]. Although I've completed the required forms and have been waiting since last week, I still can't download it this week. The website displays the following message: "You cannot download this file, since you do not have the necessary authorization yet. Your registration inquiry will now be forwarded; due to the manual review the registration may take several days, however. You will get a confirmation e-mail as soon as your download registration is finalized. You can download the requested software or other software packages only when you have received the positive confirmation." Currently, I'm unsure if there's an issue with my permissions and if I need to wait longer, or if something else is causing the delay. Thank you. [user_name] / [company_name] / Canada

The latest update for [product_name] (Service Pack 1 for [product_name] [version_no]) has been released since 8/2/2022. Many users are trying to register to download this export-restricted software. The verification of your data is handled manually and takes longer due to the high volume of requests. You need to wait until you receive the confirmation email from [company_name].

analysis.insight_summary: This thread highlights difficulties with the manual authorization and registration required to download the updated version of [product_name] for Windows 10. The user is uncertain whether delays are due to access rights or system issues, leading to confusion and frustration. The situation is compounded by a high demand for the software and a lack of immediate feedback regarding registration progress.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software update process to be straightforward, with timely approval for registration and clear feedback on their download status.
